profile.headline: Software Engineer @ PNC | Girls Who Code Alumni Advisory Council Leader
profile.summary:
After completing my degree in Computer Science from Dickinson College and refining my software engineering skills at Hackbright Academy, I joined PNC as a Technology Development Program Associate. My education laid a solid foundation in collaborative problem-solving, which I now apply to rotations in Data & Analytics, Security, Software Engineering, and Technology Operations. My ability to mentor and present complex concepts clearly has proven invaluable in these roles.

My current tenure at PNC involves shadowing and contributing to projects that enhance user security and operational efficiency. The team's dedication to innovation and excellence resonates with my personal values. Leveraging my language skills, I also support initiatives that strengthen cultural competency and diversity, bringing a global perspective to local challenges. It's a fulfilling experience to empower colleagues and drive growth within an organization that values multifaceted expertise.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Alumni Advisory Council Member
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Instructor
positions.locationName: Dallas, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description: I returned to work with Girls Who Code as a teacher for three of their Summer Immersion Program classrooms. I lead instruction and effectively facilitated an engaging and accessible virtual classroom environment for a highly diverse group of 50-60 high school students. I prepared for class each day by reviewing GWC curriculum materials in advance and adapting them to meet the needs of the students in my class. Managing a team of 5 Teaching Assistants I was also supported in classroom management, lesson delivery, logistical tasks, virtual classroom setup, etc. And as a representative I grew Girls Who Code relationships with partners,Morgan Stanley, BlackRock and London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) by serving as a representative of the organization during all virtual program activities including virtual partner engagements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Technology Development Program Associate
positions.locationName: Dallas, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: In 12-months, I rotated through four PNC technology department areas: Data & Analytics, Security, Software Engineering, and Technology Operations. I experienced an in-depth overview of application development, and gained an understanding of security and risk controls to build secure and efficient code. As an associate I shadowed and worked on software development that provided users with secure, stable, and efficient technology solutions while working iteratively and reducing toil.

positions.title: Critical Language Scholarship Alumni Ambassador
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: I presented information about my experiences as a STEM major and Critical Language Scholarship Scholar learning Japanese to potential 2023 scholarship candidates. I helped mentor current participants through the Critical Language Scholarship Alumni Support Network to help participants find academic/professional guidance. And, I organized and facilitated Critical Language Scholarship Program outreach events online to increase the number of STEM majors pursuing foreign language studies.

positions.insights: Skills: p5.js · JavaScript · Public Speaking · Teaching · Youth Mentoring

positions.title: Student Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: I developed skills and knowledge across fundamentals of data structures, algorithms, testing, front-end, back-end, and database programming using Python, Javascript, HTML, Bootstrap. Collaborating with cohort colleagues on pair-programming assignments allowed me to complete daily lab projects that helped me build databases, understand unit/integrated testing, how to utilize APIs, sessions creations, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: SQLAlchemy · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · PostgreSQL · Flask

positions.title: Critical Language Scholar
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: I was selected to participate in a rigorous government funded summer program to master the Japanese language with native speakers. I participated in daily non-English language sessions, conducted interviews with local natives and developed presentations both outside and inside of the classroom. All while, learning about Japanese culture and Okayama's efforts at tackling The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) or Global Goals, a collection of 17 interlinked global goals designed to be a "shared blueprint for peace and prosperity for people and the planet, now and into the future."
positions.insights: Skills: Presentation Skills · Teamwork · Leadership · Public Speaking · Japanese

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.locationName: Carlisle, Pennsylvania, United States
positions.description: I was selected to work along with Resident Life and Housing to oversee 3 residential buildings available to the Dickinson community. Everyday I rotated with other resident advisors to maintain communication and order around resident halls on campus. And, I administered the creation and delivery of resources used by residents in need of guidance for academic consulting, self-care, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Academic Advising · Teamwork · Event Planning · Leadership

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
I was presented with the opportunity of teaching young women from different regions of the US to strengthen and inform their abilities to pursue computer science. Rotating amongst 3 teaching teams, I develop curriculum, tutoring hours and informative panels with companies such as Bank of America, DTCC and AT&T. I also managed and taught in virtual classrooms consisting of 30 students or less, while facilitating meeting with teaching team members and leaders overseeing classroom performance.

positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Web Development · Youth Mentoring · Teaching · Public Speaking

positions.title: Academic and Co-Curricular Excellence Peer Mentor
positions.locationName: Carlisle, Pennsylvania, United States
positions.description: I conducted weekly meeting with two first-year students from underrepresented backgrounds to talk about transitioning into college life. Through conversations of course work load, social experiences and on-campus resources, these weekly meetings allowed for first years to navigate their way through Dickinson College while being able to build resourceful relationships with their peer mentors.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Academic Advising · Event Planning · Leadership

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area
positions.description: I was selected by NYC Ladders for Leaders to participate in a summer long internship to enhance professional skills and environmental exposure. I engaged in project meetings, worked on policy guideline documents and developed professional rapport with staff to facilitate the collection of quarter expenses and other projects.

honors.title: Critical Language Scholarship
honors.description: I was selected to participate in a rigorous government funded summer program to master the Japanese language with native speakers. I participated in daily language sessions that harvested a non-English speaking environment both outside and inside of the classroom, while completing assignments and projects that could further develop my reading and writing skills.
honors.issuer: Issued by Critical Language Scholarship Program · Mar 2022

honors.description: Recognized along with only 10 other women leaders on campus to be commenced into the 98th class of Wheel and Chain.
